added.idea: Children act out how a plant grows in the order seed, soil, water, sun, plant. They curl up like a seed, tuck under a blanket for soil, wiggle fingers for water, stretch their arms to the window for sun, then stand tall as a plant. The adult says each word in English and the children repeat it.

added.idea: Children play a mystery bag game. Round, square and triangle things from home or class (a plate, a folded napkin, a folded cloth) go into a pillowcase. Each child feels one without looking and says 'circle', 'square' or 'triangle' before pulling it out.
